tasks.title: Announcement #41
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Good afternoon, students. I'm sorry for the confusion regarding the deadlines for your upcoming assignments. As I wrote in this morning's e-mail, the due dates on your syllabus are incorrect. Your research paper is actually due on Wednesday the 31st, and your group presentations are due the following Friday. I regret any inconvenience this has caused. On the other hand, this means you have some extra time to complete your assignments. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out during office hours.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the assignment deadlines?

options.A: They are later than the syllabus indicates.
options.B: They have not yet been determined.
options.C: They are likely to change in the future.
options.D: They were not included in the syllabus.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：作业截止日期有什么变化？ 定位原文：the due dates on your syllabus are incorrect… you have some extra time 选项分析： A. 比 syllabus 更晚。因为“extra time”，因此正确。 B. 尚未确定。错误。 C. 未来可能变。未提及。 D. syllabus 没写。错误。

questions.stem: What is the speaker's attitude toward the situation he describes?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者态度是什么？ 定位原文：I'm sorry for the confusion… I regret any inconvenience 选项分析： A. 冷漠。错误。 B. 道歉。明显表达，因此正确。 C. 生气。没有。 D. 幽默。没有。
